Kept as a definition because the class is a real hazard whenever a gate step depends on a later step.

flakeRegistry.identity: `test` is the identity the runner prints on its Failed line: the fully qualified name for a plain test, the DisplayName string when the test declares one (`method` then records the method, for the reader).
flakeRegistry.rules: Every row is exact, owned by a ticket, dated (firstSeen) and expiring. An expired or unowned row fails the gate. Validated by eng/flake-registry.mjs; ratcheted by REGISTERED_FLAKE_COUNT there, which must move in the same commit as any growth.
flakeRegistry.retry: ONE identical retry per registered row; both outcomes are recorded in the exact-clone report's host-flake-retry step.
